title: Fear will always try to convince you that the storm is too strong and the step is too risky.
paragraphs: Fear will always try to convince you that the storm is too strong and the step is too risky.
But the same God who called Peter out of the boat is the same God walking with you today.
Sometimes the miracle doesn’t happen until you step.
“Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.” — Matthew 14:29
What step of faith do you feel God calling you to take right now? 👇
